decisions.reason: The definition defines H1_0 by H1 closure and explicitly makes no endpoint-equivalence claim here. The owning page places the trace lemma and integration-by-parts lemma (b), whose steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1 prove that later identification; the definition need not prove a deferred theorem. The separate mollifier-radius defect in that later proof is handled in its assigned review.

F2 misattributes zero values and quadratic identities to addition/derivative statements that do not contain them. This is an elementary citation omission, repaired by substituting the published exponential definitions and exp(0)=1, exp(s)exp(-s)=1; the resulting identities prove det M=1 and cosh(s)>=1. Matching, flux conservation and both error estimates remain valid with unchanged Statement.

F3 overstates the real-valued Riemann supplier. The already cited Banach-valued FTC actually supplies Bochner integrals for continuous complex curves under CC, so the Volterra construction is licensed. Clarified the two distinct integral interfaces, supplied the uniform-limit completeness argument and continuity of the running suprema, and fixed internal tags; the reflected contraction, factorial series bounds and norm difference quotients establish all conclusions without a Statement change.

The real Holder interface was applied directly to a complex derivative in F3/step 3.1. Made the necessary complex integral triangle inequality a direct dependency and applied real Holder to the measurable modulus |u prime| and 1; finite-measure inclusion likewise uses moduli. The p=2 representative corollary with finite endpoints proves existence/uniqueness, and applying it to Du proves the H2 derivative assertion. The Statement and all AC/CC hypotheses are unchanged.

The Given and F1 redundantly assume/assert product completeness, which is a conclusion of (a), but step 1.1 independently proves the zero orthogonal complement using one-dimensional completeness and Fubini. Removed the conclusion from Given and the unsupported tensor-product assertion in F1, made the slice L2 bound and square Hilbert hypothesis explicit, and constructed the diagonal domain/action only after completeness. The diagonal lemma then proves self-adjointness and coefficient uniqueness yields exactly the (1,2),(2,1) eigenspace.

The mollifier supplier allows arbitrary compact support, so delta<epsilon/4 alone does not imply interior support. Step 1.2 now fixes R>=1 containing supp rho and requires delta<epsilon/(4R), proving the precise support-sum bound. It also proves derivative commutation for the compact zero extension by AC integration by parts instead of attributing an unstated weak-derivative property to the mollifier interface. Corrected the double-conjugation wording in step 1.1. Cutoff strip bounds, converse traces and boundary identities establish the unchanged Statement.

The original simplicity clause is false because zero belongs to every kernel and is orthogonal to e_n. Added nonzero; step 6.1 already proves the stronger exact equality ker(A_D-lambda_n)=C e_n from distinct eigenvalues and coefficient uniqueness. Both domain inclusions, trace convergence and the form identity are valid. No theorem scope is weakened: the intended simplicity claim is preserved and its impossible zero-vector reading removed.
